text:
lee: Noticing several medium SAST hits stuck in triage. Compliance wants an auditable auto-escalation flow and removal of long-lived SA keys from scanner runners. Quick design?

anita: Proposal: GH Action runs as GitHub App -> write immutable audit event -> create signed evidence pointer -> then take any auto-action. If decrypt needed, call KMS-proxy for ephemeral decrypt token scoped to PR+reviewer.

michael: Agreed. Proxy example:```bash
curl -X POST https://kms-proxy.internal/issue \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $WORKLOAD_JWT\" \
  -d '{"key":"scan-keys/scan-repro","reason":"repro:5200001234","ttl":300,"pr":5200001234}'
```

sec-bot: [scan-run] nightly-scan finished: 7 medium, 1 high (auth-redirect). Report: https://scans.internal/5200001234

oncall-sre: Please DO NOT page for each aging item. Page immediately for P0/P1. For others, send an aggregated digest every 24h with list+owners+runbook link. Digest must include revoke steps for ephemeral tokens.

compliance: Retention: audit events + signed pointers 36 months. Raw artifacts need an exception. We need a sample signed audit entry before rollout.

anita: Minimal GH Action sketch:```yaml
name: scan-triage
on: [schedule, pull_request]
jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          # write audit entry first
          curl -X POST "$AUDIT_API/events" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.AUDIT_TOKEN }}" -d '{"pr": "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}", "stage": "pre-triage"}'
          # call triage
          curl -X POST "$SCANNER/api/triage" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.SCAN_APP_TOKEN }}" -d '{"pr": "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"}'
```

lee: Action items: 1) anita+michael: KMS-proxy + RBAC plan (ETA Thu) 2) anita: GH Action + audit write + PR attestation (ETA Wed) 3) oncall-sre: digest format + runbook (ETA Mon) 4) compliance: sample signed audit entry (ETA Tue). I'll open ISSUE-SEC-400 and link here.

michael: we'll remove SA keys in stages: deprecate -> migration action to swap secrets -> enforce. Keep teams informed.

lee: thanks all :thumbsup:
